$comment: wal.sh/tools/display v0.2.1 control messages; one schema per op

frames.pal16: binary, w*h bytes 0..15, optional 2-byte big-endian sequence prefix
frames.hex: text, h lines of w hex digits, LF-terminated, optional closing blank line; first character is not {
frames.rgb24: binary, w*h*3 bytes, optional 2-byte prefix; relay input only

unknown_fields: ignored: every schema has additionalProperties true
